steps.description: Show that your robot can perform the following: 1. The robot display "Red", "Blue", "Green" with an interval of 0.5 second

Show that your robot can perform the following: 1. The robot display "Red", "Blue", "Green" with an interval of 0.1 second 2. When the button is pressed and held, - the robot will randomly select a colour - Display find the colour name on the LCD Screen - For example, red colour is randomly select, Display "Find Red" on the LCD Screen 3. Perform step 1 again

Show that your robot can perform the following: 1. The robot display "Red", "Blue", "Green" with an interval of 0.1 second 2. When the button is pressed and released, - the robot will randomly select a colour - the robot will display find the colour name on the LCD Screen until the colour sensor detect the selected colour - For example, red colour is selected randomly, display "Find Red" on the LCD Screen until the colour sensor detects red 3. When the colour sensor detects the selected colour, perform step 1 again

Show that your robot can perform the following: 1. The robot display "Red", "Blue", "Green" with an interval of 0.1 second 2. When the button is pressed and released, - the robot will randomly select a colour - the robot will display find the colour name on the LCD Screen until the colour sensor detect the selected colour - For example, red colour is selected randomly, display "Find Red" on the LCD Screen until the colour sensor detects red 3. When the colour sensor detects the selected colour, display found the colour name on the LCD Screen for 1 second - For example, the colour sensor has successfully detected red, display "Found Red" on the LCD Screen for 1 second 4. Perform step 1 again
